feedPolicy: Declared west entrances only, at the panel figures (scaled or overridden only where a scenario says so): fluids get perMinute/3600 per tick plus what they refused before (carry capped at one second of supply); the iron belt gets a credit of perMinute/3600 per tick (capped at 8), one plate per credit on alternating lanes. drawPolicy: Declared outputs only, at the scenario figure: fluids remove perMinute/3600 per tick plus the unmet carry (capped at one second) from the outlet pipe; the sulfur belt is emptied every 4 ticks up to its credit. Once a second every outlet is checked for any other fluid (or, on the belt, any other item).
researchPolicy: All recipes enabled (advanced oil processing, sulfur processing, lubricant and the rest); fast inserter stack bonus zero; bulk inserter unlock-equivalent capacity bonus +1 only
